claim: The additional charge for RDS Extended Support automatically stops when you upgrade to an engine version that's covered under standard support or delete the database that's running a major version past the RDS end of standard support date.

evidence.quote: The additional charge for RDS Extended Support automatically stops when you take one of the following actions:
Upgrade to an engine version that's covered under standard support.
Delete the database that's running a major version past the RDS end of standard support date.
